1.tell: only option that isolates the causal variable (urchin exclusion) while holding warming constant

2.tell: 'does not by itself indicate' — hedged two-clause qualifier main idea; others overclaim or invent a comparison

3.tell: 'only partly, which points to' — partial-explanation hedge; B/C/D each assert a single mechanism

4.tell: 'reflects X rather than Y' frame separating vocabulary from grammar; D is the overgeneralized rule

5.tell: two coordinated quantitative facts rather than one; B is a striking-but-suspicious equivalence

6.tell: 'may be a byproduct ... rather than' — modal hedge; A/D are absolutes

7.tell: concessive 'point to shared storage, but' shape; B/D are twins, chose the one whose second clause qualifies rather than negates

8.tell: only option describing divergent trends (monotonic fall vs peak-then-decline), which is what a shading tradeoff text needs

9.tell: 'bears on one stage ... leaves open' — scope-limiting hedge; B claims establishment, A overgeneralizes

10.tell: only numerically explicit option; the asymmetry it reports (8 pts vs 1) is the point such a text would make

11.tell: sample-size caveat undercutting the headline average — the sophisticated data reading

12.tell: 'gives a better estimate' — the measured comparative; B ('cannot be interpreted') and D ('should vanish') are absolutes

13.tell: 'owes less to X than to what lies beneath it' — redirects cause to the substrate, the only non-literal completion

14.tell: divergence pattern (one rises throughout, other rises then falls below baseline) is the only one that would motivate a caveat

15.tell: 'a real difference within a shallow layer rather than in total' — scope-limiting reframe

16.tell: 'most is attributable to X, though a modest advantage remains' — partial-deflation hedge, classic key shape

17.tell: only option supplying physical evidence of readers beyond the registered borrower; others describe rules or dates

18.tell: counterintuitive pairing (more burrows, less retreat); C is the too-tidy monotonic distractor

19.tell: 'records observation at its own house rather than transmission' — the rather-than reframe; others posit copying errors
